craft_notes: Sthāyin: the positive negation. Sanskrit-first: na...na...niṣkalatvena...sakalatve na → L4 preserves double na. Rows: row 1 (letter/bodies uncut). Close: wholeness (the landing word). Rejected: 'holistic' — killed: wholeness plain; 'essence' — killed: partlessness IS the claim.

lines: Not by letter-division, nor by bodies divided:
higher-ness is partlessness — that, not, in wholeness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet

reads_against.argmap: Or does higher-ness evade all division? → Division fails twice — higher-ness abides only as whole partlessness.
c1_essence: Not by letter, not by body: higher-ness is partlessness.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with jijñāsā (wonder sharpened into seeking)
